ui.app.name: Mera Deen Safar
ui.note.main:
Duas and ayat are taken from well-known authentic books.
Still, please verify with a scholar. 🤲
ui.home.azS: Start the day with the remembrance of Allah
ui.jm.title: Jumu'ah Mubarak 🕌
ui.jm.homeOnly: This checklist appears on Home on Fridays.
ui.jm.durood: Abundant salawat on the Prophet ﷺ
ui.jm.jaldi: Go early to the masjid, listen to the khutbah attentively
ui.prog.title: From missing salah to praying
ui.prog.sub: Build the salah habit step by step
ui.prog.desc: 7 stages — start with one salah and grow to all five, then a firm 40-day habit.
ui.prog.doneBig: You have completed all the stages!
ui.prog.doneSub: May Allah grant you steadfastness. Now just keep the habit going.
ui.prog.zero: No worries, start again today — Allah sees your effort 💚
ui.prog.smChk: I also prayed the sunnah mu'akkadah today
ui.prog.warn: All five prayers are obligatory (fard). This is only a way to build the habit — make up (qada) any prayer you miss and keep trying to pray the rest too.
ui.st.0.tip: Make just Maghrib firm — it has the shortest and easiest time.
ui.st.1.tip: Add Isha to Maghrib. Pray it before you sleep.
ui.st.2.tip: Now Fajr. Set an alarm and try to sleep early.
ui.st.3.tip: Add Asr — take 10 minutes out in the middle of work.
ui.st.4.tip: MashaAllah! Now Zuhr too — all five complete.
ui.st.5.tip: All five prayers for 40 days — the habit becomes firm.
ui.st.6.tip: The sunnah mu'akkadah along with the fard, and congregation wherever possible.
ui.pg.all: You have completed the whole program. May Allah grant you steadfastness!
ui.ib.timesRef: {m} · Asr {a}. Prefer your local masjid's timings.
ui.sf.legend: Salah 10 · Sunnah 10 · Adhkar 15 · Good deed 5 · Reflection 10 · Deed 10 · Istighfar 3/33 · Jumu'ah 5 · Qada 5 (max 50) · Stage +50
ui.ay.tomorrow: A new ayah and a new deed tomorrow 🌱
ui.nk.ph: What good did you do today?
ui.nk.private: Hiding good deeds is better — this stays only on your phone.
ui.nk.weekMsg: MashaAllah! Every good deed is rewarded at least tenfold (Al-An'am 6:160).
ui.nk.weekEmpty: Do this week's first good deed today 🌱
ui.mu.quote: “Let every soul look to what it has sent forth for tomorrow.” — Al-Hashr 59:18
ui.mu.q1: 1. What good did I do today? (gratitude)
ui.mu.q3: 3. What will I do better tomorrow? (intention)
ui.mu.istRef: The Prophet ﷺ sought forgiveness 100 times a day
ui.mu.note: This is saved only on your phone. The door of repentance to Allah is always open 💚
ui.hb.dua: O Allah! I seek Your refuge from bad character, bad deeds and bad desires.
ui.hb.empty: No trackers. Choose a habit you want to leave — only you will see it.
ui.hb.ph: e.g. swearing, backbiting, too much phone
ui.hb.note: “Do not despair of the mercy of Allah” (Az-Zumar 39:53). Slipping is human — getting up again with repentance is the real success.
ui.hb.slipTxt: Make tawbah: Astaghfirullah. Allah loves those who repent (Al-Baqarah 2:222). Start again?
ui.set.title: Settings
ui.set.permNa: Notifications not available in this browser
ui.set.remNote: Note: without a server, reminders only arrive while the app/tab is open or in the background.
ui.set.backupTxt: All data is only on this phone/browser. Save a backup file.
ui.set.name: Name
ui.fm.remoteEmpty: People on other phones can send their share code — paste it here.
ui.fm.privacy: Only name, salah count and streak are shared — never reflections, habits or qada.
ui.fm.note:
The aim is not competition, but encouraging one another.
“Help one another in righteousness and piety” — Al-Ma'idah 5:2
ui.cf.progOff: Stop the program? (Your salah record will be kept)
ui.cf.wipe: All of this profile's records will be erased. Are you sure?
ui.cf.restore: All data will be replaced from the backup. Continue?

ui.sh.hausla:
Assalamu Alaikum! 🌙 Don't forget today's salah times. May Allah keep us all steadfast. 🤲
— {n} (Mera Deen Safar)
ui.onb.desc: Small daily deeds — salah, sunnah, dhikr and good deeds — that make faith part of everyday life.
ui.onb.name: Your name
ui.onb.note: All data stays only on your phone.
ui.nt.Sb: Start the day with the remembrance of Allah — 10 minutes.
ui.qz.title: Qada prayers
ui.qz.introTxt: Estimate how many prayers were missed, then make them up a little each day. Every step counts 🌱
ui.qz.missedN: {n} prayers from past days weren't ticked.
ui.qz.emptyBig: Your qada journey hasn't started yet
ui.qz.emptyTxt: First estimate how many prayers are owed, then make them up a little each day. Allah sees your effort 💚
ui.qz.missTxt: Some prayers from past days weren't ticked. If they really were missed, add them to qada; if you prayed them, just leave it.
ui.qz.eta: At this pace, complete in ~{s}, InshaAllah
ui.qz.etaGoal: At {g} qada a day, complete in ~{s}, InshaAllah
ui.qz.complete: 🎉 Alhamdulillah! All qada made up. May Allah accept it.
ui.qz.ptsRef: Each qada +{p} points (max {c} a day). Tip: pray one qada with each fard prayer — {d} qada a day, easily 🌿
ui.qz.hadith: “The most beloved deed to Allah is the one done consistently, even if it is small.”
ui.qz.calcTxt: Estimate how many days of prayers were missed. Each day = 5 fard{w}.
ui.qz.balighHint: If you don't remember the signs of puberty, many scholars take the age of 15 — please verify with a scholar.
ui.qz.minusHint: Days on which you did pray, or for women the days of menstruation/post-natal bleeding.
ui.qz.witrHint: In Hanafi fiqh Witr is wajib, so it is also made up
ui.qz.resTxt: At {k} qada a day (1 day's worth), they can be made up in ~{s}, InshaAllah. Don't worry — Allah sees your effort 💚
ui.qz.calcNote: Year = 365 days, month = 30 days (approx.). If in doubt, counting a little more is the cautious choice.
ui.qz.editTxt: If you know your count, enter the remaining number for each prayer here.
ui.qz.offNote: (the record of made-up qada will be kept)
ui.qz.cfOff: Turn off the qada tracker? (The record of made-up qada will be kept)
ui.qz.allDoneS: May Allah accept every prayer of yours and grant you steadfastness.
ui.qz.mTxt: Keep selected the prayers that were really missed. If you prayed one but forgot to tick it, tap it to remove it.
ui.qz.mWitr: Witr will be added along with Isha.
ui.qz.tsMissOk: {n} prayers added to qada — may Allah make it easy 🤲
ui.qz.note1: 🕰️ Qada can be prayed at any time except the disliked (makruh) times: Sunrise (as the sun rises), Zawal (exact midday) and Sunset (as the sun sets).
ui.qz.note2: For the method and count of qada, please verify with a scholar. 🤲

az.kursi.m: Allah — there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all… (Al-Baqarah 2:255). Whoever reads it in the morning is protected until evening, and in the evening until morning.

az.quls.m: Surah al-Ikhlas, al-Falaq and an-Nas — reciting them 3 times suffices you against everything.

az.mulk.m: We have entered the morning and all dominion belongs to Allah. O Lord! I ask You for the good of this day, and seek refuge from its evil, from laziness, the evil of old age, and from the punishment of the Fire and the grave.

az.bika.m: O Allah! By Your command we enter the morning/evening, by You we live and die, and to You is the return.

az.sayyid.m: O Allah! You are my Lord… I acknowledge Your favours upon me and confess my sins, so forgive me, for none forgives sins but You. (Whoever says it with certainty and dies that day/night is among the people of Jannah.)

az.afini.m: O Allah! Grant me well-being in my body, my hearing and my sight. I seek Your refuge from disbelief, poverty and the punishment of the grave.

az.hasbi.m: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity except Him. In Him I put my trust, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.

az.bism.m: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the heavens can cause harm; He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

az.radi.m: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion and Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet.

az.hayy.m: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer! By Your mercy I seek help; set right all my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.

az.kalimat.m: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of all that He has created.

az.subhan.m: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him. Whoever says it 100 times has his sins forgiven, even if they are like the foam of the sea.

az.istighfar.m: I seek Allah's forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance. The Prophet ﷺ sought forgiveness 100 times a day.

az.durood.m: O Allah! Send Your mercy and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.

du.neend.m: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after death (sleep), and to Him is the rising.

du.sona.m: O Allah! In Your name I die (sleep) and live (wake).

du.khana1.m: In the name of Allah. If you forget: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ (Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirahu).

du.khana2.m: Praise be to Allah who fed me this and provided it without any power of mine. (Past sins are forgiven.)

du.nikalna.m: In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.

du.dakhil.m: In the name of Allah we enter and leave, and upon our Lord Allah we rely. Then greet your family with salam.

du.bath1.m: In the name of Allah. O Allah! I seek Your refuge from the male and female unclean jinn (devils). (Left foot first.)

du.bath2.m: (O Allah) I seek Your forgiveness. (Right foot first.)

du.wudu.m: I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah… and that Muhammad ﷺ is His servant and Messenger. The 8 gates of Jannah are opened. (Before wudu: Bismillah)

du.masjid1.m: O Allah! Open for me the gates of Your mercy. (Right foot first.)

du.masjid2.m: O Allah! I ask You of Your bounty. (Left foot first.)

du.kapray.m: Praise be to Allah who clothed me with this and provided it without any power of mine.

du.safar.m: Glory be to the One who subjected this to us, for we could not have done so ourselves, and to our Lord we shall return.

du.azan.m: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the prayer to be established! Grant Muhammad ﷺ al-wasilah and excellence, and raise him to the praised station You promised him. (Intercession will be granted.)

du.cheenk.m: All praise is for Allah · May Allah have mercy on you · May Allah guide you and set your affairs right.

du.gussa.m: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Shaytan. If standing, sit down; and stay silent.

du.fikr.m: O Allah! I seek Your refuge from anxiety, grief, helplessness, laziness, miserliness, cowardice, the burden of debt and being overpowered by people.

du.musibat.m: Indeed we belong to Allah and to Him we shall return.

du.yunus.m: There is no deity except You; glory be to You; indeed I have been among the wrongdoers.

du.majlis.m: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise; there is no deity except You; I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You. (Expiation for the gathering's mistakes.)

du.barish.m: O Allah! Make it beneficial rain.

du.iftar.m: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, InshaAllah.

du.jazak.m: May Allah reward you with goodness. (Saying this is the best thanks.)

du.walidain.m: My Lord! Have mercy on them both as they raised me when I was small.

du.ilm.m: My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.

du.hasana.t: Good in this world and the next
du.hasana.m: Our Lord! Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the punishment of the Fire. (The dua the Prophet ﷺ made most often.)

du.dil.m: O Turner of hearts! Keep my heart firm upon Your religion.

content.su.0: Eating and drinking with the right hand
content.su.2: Being first to give salam — the one who greets first is closer to Allah
content.su.3: Meeting your brother with a smile — that too is charity
content.su.5: 2 rak'ahs of Tahiyyat al-Wudu after wudu
content.su.8: Drinking water sitting down, in 3 breaths
content.su.9: Putting on the right shoe first, and taking off the left first
content.su.11: Responding to the adhan and reading the dua after it
content.su.12: 2 sunnah before Fajr — better than the world and all in it
content.su.13: Making dua for a brother in his absence
content.su.14: Visiting a sick person (or asking after them by phone)
content.su.15: Giving someone a gift — love increases
content.su.16: Removing something harmful from the path
content.su.17: Cleaning the plate and licking the fingers after eating
content.su.18: Ayat al-Kursi after every fard prayer
content.su.19: Before sleeping, reciting the three Quls, blowing into the hands and wiping over the body
content.su.20: Tasbih of Fatimah before sleeping: 33 SubhanAllah, 33 Alhamdulillah, 34 Allahu Akbar
content.su.21: Staying quiet / sitting down when angry
content.su.23: Giving salam on entering the home
content.su.27: A voluntary fast on Monday or Thursday
content.su.29: The kaffarat al-majlis dua at the end of a gathering
content.su.32: Entering the masjid with the right foot first
content.su.33: Abundant salawat — 10 mercies for each one

ay.0.m: Remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me.
ay.0.a: Spend 5 minutes today only in dhikr — SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah.

ay.1.m: Seek help through patience and prayer; indeed Allah is with the patient.
ay.1.a: Today, instead of complaining about a worry, pray 2 rak'ahs and make dua.

ay.2.m: I am near; I answer the call of the caller when he calls Me.
ay.2.a: Today, ask Allah for something from your heart in your own language.

ay.3.m: Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity.
ay.3.a: Today, hand one of your burdens over to Allah and read the dua of this ayah.

ay.4.m: Those who restrain anger and pardon people — Allah loves the doers of good.

ay.5.m: By the mercy of Allah you were gentle with them; had you been harsh, they would have left you.
ay.5.a: Today, speak gently with your family; don't raise your voice.

ay.6.m: Worship Allah, and do good to parents, relatives, orphans and neighbours.
ay.6.a: Today, check on a neighbour or send them something.

ay.7.m: When you are greeted, respond with a better greeting.
ay.7.a: Today, answer every salam in full: Wa alaikumus-salam wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh.

ay.8.m: Help one another in righteousness and piety, not in sin and aggression.
ay.8.a: Today, help someone in a good deed.

ay.9.m: Eat and drink, but do not be wasteful.
ay.9.a: Don't waste food today — take only as much as you will eat.

ay.10.m: Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
ay.10.a: When restless, say SubhanAllah 33 times instead of reaching for the phone.

ay.11.m: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you.
ay.11.a: Today, write down 3 blessings to be grateful for.

ay.12.m: Allah commands justice, excellence and giving to relatives.
ay.12.a: Today, call or visit a relative.

ay.13.m: Do not say “uff” to your parents; speak to them with honour.
ay.13.a: Today, speak gently with your parents and make dua for them.

ay.14.m: Do not pursue what you have no knowledge of; hearing, sight and heart will all be questioned.
ay.14.a: Today, don't forward anything without checking it.

ay.15.m: Say: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
ay.15.a: Today, learn one new thing about the deen and tell someone.

ay.16.m: Let them pardon and overlook — do you not love that Allah should forgive you?
ay.16.a: Today, take the first step to end an old grudge.

ay.17.m: Tell the believing men to lower their gaze — that is purer for them.
ay.17.a: Today, guard your gaze, especially on your phone.

ay.18.m: The servants of the Most Merciful walk humbly on the earth, and when the ignorant address them, they say “peace”.
ay.18.a: Today, instead of arguing back, say “salam” and let it go.

ay.19.m: Prayer restrains from indecency and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of Allah is greatest.
ay.19.a: Today, try to pray every salah on time.

ay.20.m: Do not turn your cheek away from people, nor walk arrogantly.
ay.20.a: Today, meet everyone — young and old — with a smile and attention.

ay.21.m: O you who believe! Remember Allah abundantly.
ay.21.a: Today, keep dhikr on your tongue while you work.

ay.22.m: Do not despair of the mercy of Allah; Allah forgives all sins.
ay.22.a: Make sincere tawbah today — 100 times istighfar.

ay.23.m: If someone brings you news, verify it.
ay.23.a: Today, don't share any news on WhatsApp without verifying it.

ay.24.m: The believers are brothers, so make peace between your brothers.
ay.24.a: Today, try to reconcile two people who are upset — or reconcile yourself.

ay.25.m: Let no people mock another people, nor call each other by offensive names.
ay.25.a: Today, avoid mocking anyone or calling them names.

ay.26.m: Avoid suspicion, do not spy, and do not backbite.
ay.26.a: Completely avoid backbiting today — if it starts in a gathering, change the topic.

ay.27.m: Let every soul look to what it has sent forth for tomorrow (the Hereafter).
ay.27.a: Be sure to do your night reflection tonight.

ay.28.m: Whoever relies on Allah, He is sufficient for him.
ay.28.a: Today, say “Hasbiyallah” over one worry and trust Him.

ay.29.m: And proclaim the blessing of your Lord.
ay.29.a: Today, tell someone about a favour Allah has done for you.

ay.30.a: Today, encourage a troubled friend by sharing this ayah.

ay.31.m: Except those who believe, do good deeds, and urge one another to truth and patience.
ay.31.a: Today, lovingly remind someone of a good deed.

ay.32.m: Establish prayer, give zakah, and bow with those who bow.
ay.32.a: Today, pray at least one salah in congregation.

ay.33.m: Allah and His angels send blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ — you too send blessings and peace upon him.

ay.34.m: Our Lord! Grant us mercy from Yourself and provide guidance for us in our affair.
ay.34.a: Today, read this dua before making a decision.

content.nk.1: Call your parents or sit with them
content.nk.2: Give a small charity — even 10 rupees
content.nk.3: Give water to someone who is thirsty

content.nk.9: Help someone pay a debt or bill
content.nk.10: Tell young children a story of the Prophets
content.nk.11: Try to reconcile with an upset relative
content.nk.12: Teach someone an ayah of the Quran
content.nk.13: Do a task for an elderly person

content.nk.16: Remove a thorn/stone from the path
content.nk.19: Help a student with their studies
content.nk.20: Pay a worker on time and generously
content.nk.21: Spend an hour away from your phone with family
content.nk.22: Send food to someone — neighbours first
content.nk.26: Help an orphan or intend to sponsor one
content.nk.27: Take someone with you to the masjid on Friday
content.nk.28: Apologise to someone whose heart you hurt
content.nk.29: A family salah or study circle at home
